adapter.backend: Hybrid WebGPU PBD predictor + CPU XPBD collision/self-contact corrector
adapter.hybrid: GPU integration, colored stretch/bend and vertex-contact predictor. CPU XPBD corrects actual mesh contacts, self contacts and seam equalities. WASM f64 diagnostics.

scope: Automated module, real-browser and independent discrete geometry assertions. No real-fabric calibration, physical GPU speed, continuous collision or human-fit claim.
